title: Disaster Recovery Runbook Compiler
description: Compiles disaster recovery runbooks. Enforces: required sections present (scope, triggers, RTO/RPO, restore steps, verification, rollback, escalation), all referenced scripts/dashboards/jobs exist, command blocks are fenced, last-reviewed date valid, owner set.

error_codes.DR001: dr-runbook-spec.json missing — required: title, owner, lastReviewed, sections{}
error_codes.DR002: Runbook missing required section(s): scope, triggers, prerequisites, restoreSteps, verification, rollback, escalation
error_codes.DR003: RTO and RPO targets not declared in runbook
error_codes.DR004: Command block not properly fenced with code block markers
error_codes.DR005: Referenced backup artifact or verification result not linked
error_codes.DR006: lastReviewed is not a valid ISO-8601 date or owner is empty
